unit_rules.name: The Raven
unit_rules.text: This model is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. Each time this model is set up on the Battlefield using Deep Strike or a similar rule, until the end of the Battle Round weapons equipped by this model have +[Precision]+ and +[Ignores Cover]+.

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Raven
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit, this model has the +Stealth+ keyword.
